files.content: .block-data-table24{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:128px 0;color:#0a0a0a;background:#fff;font:400 14px/20px system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:left}.block-data-table24 *{box-sizing:border-box}.dt24-inner{max-width:1024px;padding:0 32px;margin:auto}.block-data-table24 h2{margin:0;font-size:24px;font-weight:700;line-height:32px;letter-spacing:-.6px}.dt24-description{color:#737373;font-size:16px;line-height:24px;margin:8px 0 32px}.dt24-scroll{overflow-x:auto}.block-data-table24 table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;text-align:left;table-layout:fixed}.block-data-table24 td{height:64px;vertical-align:middle;padding:16px 0}.block-data-table24 td:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid #e5e5e5}.block-data-table24 th{font-weight:600}.dt24-group{height:41px;line-height:24px;border-top:1px solid #e5e5e5;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e5e5;background:#f5f5f5}.dt24-group th{padding:8px;text-align:left}.block-data-table24 a{color:inherit;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;display:block}.block-data-table24 a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.block-data-table24 a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a3a3a3;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:3px}.dt24-amount{font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}.dt24-tax{margin-left:12px;white-space:nowrap;color:#737373;font-size:12px;line-height:16px}.dt24-sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}.dt24-empty{padding:24px;text-align:center;color:#737373}@media(max-width:700px){.block-data-table24{padding:64px 0}.dt24-inner{padding:0 16px}.block-data-table24 table{min-width:900px}}
